coverageNote: Federated global commercial/transport aviation accident expansion. Records are sourced from official investigation authorities where available. This is an expanding index, not a claim of complete worldwide coverage. Fatality fields reflect verified values available in the cited source set; some ongoing investigations may be incomplete.

items.title: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752
items.summary: The aircraft was shot down shortly after departure from Tehran. The TSB of Canada participated under ICAO Annex 13 and hosts the Iranian final safety investigation report and supporting material.
items.probableCause: Official safety investigation material addresses the missile engagement and the chain of events leading to the loss of the aircraft.

items.title: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 8303
items.summary: The scheduled passenger flight crashed in a residential area near Jinnah International Airport during a second approach to Karachi.
items.probableCause: Use the final Pakistan AAIB report for the authoritative causal and contributing-factor findings; the dashboard does not substitute a secondary single-cause label.

items.title: Air India Express Flight 1344
items.summary: The aircraft overran the tabletop runway during landing at Kozhikode and broke into sections beyond the runway end.
items.probableCause: Refer to the AAIB India final report for the formal causal and contributing-factor findings.

items.title: Sriwijaya Air Flight 182
items.summary: The aircraft entered an upset after increasing thrust asymmetry during climb and impacted the Java Sea.
items.probableCause: KNKT identified interacting autothrottle mechanical issues, delayed system response, unresolved maintenance history and inadequate upset prevention/recovery training among the contributing factors.

items.title: China Eastern Airlines Flight MU5735
items.summary: The aircraft departed cruise altitude rapidly and impacted mountainous terrain while operating a scheduled domestic passenger flight.
items.probableCause: Cause remains under investigation in the official CAAC process; no final causal conclusion is asserted here.

items.title: Tara Air Flight 197
items.aircraft: De Havilland Canada DHC-6-300 Twin Otter
items.authority: Nepal Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation
items.summary: The Twin Otter crashed in mountainous terrain while operating a domestic passenger service in Nepal.
items.probableCause: Refer to the Nepal accident investigation final report for formal findings and safety recommendations.

items.title: Yeti Airlines Flight 691
items.authority: Nepal Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation
items.summary: The ATR 72 crashed during approach to Pokhara International Airport on a scheduled domestic passenger flight.
items.probableCause: Use the Nepal investigation report for the authoritative causal analysis and contributing factors.

items.title: Haneda Runway Collision — Japan Airlines Flight 516 / Japan Coast Guard
items.summary: A Japan Airlines A350 and a Japan Coast Guard DHC-8 collided on the runway at Haneda. All occupants of the A350 evacuated; five Coast Guard occupants died.
items.probableCause: Final causal findings remain subject to the JTSB investigation; the dashboard does not assign a cause before the final report.

items.title: Alaska Airlines Flight 1282
items.summary: The left mid-exit door plug separated in flight during climb, producing rapid depressurization and substantial aircraft damage.
items.probableCause: NTSB determined that inadequate manufacturing training, guidance and oversight contributed to the missing fasteners that allowed the door plug to separate.

items.title: Singapore Airlines Flight SQ321
items.summary: The flight encountered a rapid sequence of vertical-acceleration changes associated with severe turbulence; occupants who were not restrained were thrown from their seats.
items.probableCause: TSIB preliminary findings describe the turbulence and acceleration sequence; use the final/published investigation record for formal conclusions.

items.title: Saurya Airlines CRJ-200 Accident
items.authority: Nepal Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation
items.summary: The CRJ-200 crashed shortly after takeoff from Kathmandu during a non-revenue positioning/maintenance-related flight.
items.probableCause: Use the Nepal final report for the authoritative causal chain and recommendations.

items.title: Voepass Flight 2283
items.summary: The ATR 72 entered an uncontrolled descent and crashed in Vinhedo. All 58 passengers and four crew members died.
items.probableCause: CENIPA published the final technical report in July 2026, including findings and safety recommendations related to the accident sequence and icing-related operational issues.

items.title: Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243
items.authority: Kazakhstan Ministry of Transport Investigation Commission
items.summary: The aircraft declared an emergency and crashed near Aktau while diverting from its planned route. Kazakhstan authorities reported 38 deaths and 29 survivors.
items.probableCause: Final causal findings remain pending in the Annex 13 investigation; no final cause is asserted in the dashboard.

items.title: Jeju Air Flight 2216
items.summary: The Boeing 737-800 overran the runway during landing at Muan and was destroyed in the subsequent impact and fire.
items.probableCause: The investigation remains ongoing; the dashboard intentionally does not assign a final cause before ARAIB publishes its conclusions.

items.title: Air Busan Flight BX391 Ground Fire
items.summary: A fire occurred on the A321 while the aircraft was at Gimhae International Airport before departure; occupants evacuated and the aircraft was substantially damaged.
items.probableCause: Investigation ongoing; no final cause is asserted before the ARAIB final report.

items.title: Delta Connection Flight 4819
items.summary: The CRJ-900 impacted the runway during landing, lost major structural components, caught fire and came to rest inverted; all occupants evacuated.
items.probableCause: Investigation remains open. The preliminary report contains factual information only and should not be treated as a final cause determination.

items.title: Air India Flight AI171
items.status: Investigation ongoing / preliminary report and 2026 interim statement published
items.summary: The Boeing 787-8 crashed shortly after takeoff from Ahmedabad on a flight to London Gatwick. The fatalities field here records the 241 onboard deaths; separate ground fatalities are not folded into this field until the final investigation record provides a reconciled total.
items.probableCause: Investigation remains ongoing; no final causal conclusion is asserted here.
